# 2 Baruch Chapter 76 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**76:1** And it came to pass after all these things that I, Baruch, came to the people and told them all the words of this vision, and I exhorted them with many words.

**76:2** And I said to them: "Behold, I go to my fathers according to the way of all the earth; but do not abandon the way of the Lord."

**76:3** "For the Lord is faithful, and will repay to every one his deeds."

**76:4** "Be not afraid of the evil which has seized you, for evil will pass away; and do not be anxious because of the distress which has come upon you, for the Mighty One will deliver you."

**76:5** And it came to pass, after I had spoken to the people all these words, that I, Baruch, departed from them.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering arbitrated from EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA. Where translators diverged, SOPHIA selected the rendering best balancing accuracy, readability, and theological fidelity.*
